topic: three things google sees differently: mobile, alt text, page title
hook: Google doesn't see your website the way you do. Three facts most designers miss.
caption:
Comment LEARN and I'll send you my free SEO starter guide. Follow for one SEO and web design lesson every day.

3 facts most designers miss.

Google mostly ranks the phone version of your site, so a gorgeous desktop layout that falls apart on an iPhone is the version that gets judged. It can't see your images either, only the alt text you write for them. And it reads your page title early, which on a lot of sites still just says Home.

Fix that today: "Roof Repair in Austin" beats "Home" every time.

topic: meta description does not rank but decides clicks
hook: Your meta description doesn't help you rank on Google. At all.
caption:
Comment LEARN and I'll send you my free SEO starter guide. Follow for a lesson every day.

Surprise.

Google has said the meta description isn't used for ranking, which shocks a lot of people who spent 3 hours stuffing theirs with keywords for Google in 2019. But it's often the 2 lines people read under your link, so it decides whether they click. "Welcome to our website" loses to "Same-week repairs. Free inspections. Call today."

Short version? Write it like an ad. What you do, where you do it, and one reason to click today instead of tomorrow.

#seo #webdesign #seotips #websitetips #seoforbeginners

topic: core web vitals: lcp inp cls explained simply
hook: If your website takes forever to load on a phone, Google noticed too.
caption:
Comment LEARN and I'll send you my free SEO starter guide. Follow for a lesson every day.

Google measures 3 things about speed, called Core Web Vitals: LCP (how fast the main content shows), INP (how fast the page reacts to a tap) and CLS (whether things jump while loading).

The usual fixes: compress images, cut heavy scripts, set sizes on images and ads.

topic: google maps local ranking: relevance, distance, prominence
hook: Paying Google won't move you up on Maps. These 3 things will.
caption:
Comment LEARN and I'll send you my free SEO starter guide. Follow for one SEO and web design lesson a day.

Nobody can sell you a better spot on Google Maps. Google says so in its own Business Profile help pages, and then it lists the 3 things that decide local results: relevance, distance and prominence.

Distance you can't change. A roofer in Tulsa is where he is.

The other 2 are on you. Fill in every field, keep your hours right, post photos of real jobs and answer every review, even the 1 star ones.

Free. Most shops skip it.
